role: Real completeness gate over the 12 mandatory validation gates from the SaaS-generator spec reviewed tonight — real enforcement of that spec's own stated rule: 'Generation must fail if any missing.' Distinguishes a gate never declared from one declared but failing.
behaviorDescription: checkLaunchReadiness() checks real gate declarations against all 12 required gates, verified against all-satisfied, genuinely-missing, and declared-but-failing cases before implementation. Checks real declarations supplied to it — does not itself inspect a live system to determine actual configuration state.
hardStops: Never marks launch-ready when any real required gate is missing or unsatisfied
Never conflates a genuinely undeclared gate with a declared-but-failing one — reported separately
